entities.summary: United Republic, a political institution in Tanzania during Nyerere, Ujamaa, and the Union (1964–1964). Grew from Zanzibar Revolution 1964. Led to the emergence of Union of Tanganyika and Zanzibar and Arusha Declaration 1967.
